title: God in His Love For Us
print: the owner's photo of his 1985 book (641.jpg), each line read off the page at its system and row; the rulings (data/crops/641/rulings.json) put in what the page prints where the base row differs: "forced" -> "force" (words, crops 641-730.jpg, 641-1446.jpg, 641-1572.jpg, judge-634 (Opus, effort max)).

stanzas.text: God in His love for us lent us this planet,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Gave it a purpose in time and in space:
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Small as a spark from the fire of creation,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 3, row 1. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Cradle of life and the home of our race.
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 4, row 1. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Thanks be to God for its bounty and beauty,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Life that sustains us in body and mind:
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Plenty for all, if we learn how to share it,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 3, row 2. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Riches undreamed of to fathom and find.
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 4, row 2. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Long have our human wars ruined its harvest;
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Long has earth bowed to the terror of force;
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Long have we wasted what others have need of,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 3, row 3. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Poisoned the fountain of life at its source.
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 4, row 3. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Earth is the Lord's: it is ours to enjoy it,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 1, row 4. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Ours, as His stewards, to farm and defend.
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 2, row 4. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: From its pollution, misuse, and destruction,
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 3, row 4. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Good Lord, deliver us, world without end!
stanzas.from: 641.jpg system 4, row 4. (placed off the page by from-634 (Opus))

replaces.text:
God in His love for us lent us this planet,
Gave it a purpose in time and in space:
Small as a spark from the fire of creation,
Cradle of life and the home of our race.

Thanks be to God for its bounty and beauty,
Life that sustains us in body and mind:
Plenty for all, if we learn how to share it,
Riches undreamed of to fathom and find.

Earth is the Lord's: it is ours to enjoy it,
Ours, as His stewards, to farm and defend.
From its pollution, misuse, and destruction,
Good Lord, deliver us, world without end!
